evidence_mode.limitations: No live keyboard navigation, focus-trap test, screen reader, or touch-device interaction was performed. All findings are Inferred from static HTML fetched from live component example iframes and from govuk-frontend CSS/JS source. Touch target measurements are CSS-computed (not live bounding-box). A keyboard trap cannot be confirmed absent without a live Tab-cycle. The primary pattern URL (https://design-system.service.gov.uk/patterns/multi-step-form/) returned 404; the audit was conducted against the canonical equivalent at /patterns/complete-multiple-tasks/ plus all referenced component example pages.

context.user_type: citizen completing a multi-step government service application (e.g. licence, benefit, permit)
context.task: Complete a multi-step government application form: navigate task list, answer question pages, review answers, submit
context.dense_state: Task list with 7 items across 2 groups (some Completed, some Incomplete); check-your-answers page with 9 data rows and 9 adjacent Change links; date input with 3 adjacent narrow fields
context.method: Path 2 / WebFetch DOM-fallback — curl fetch of live example iframes and govuk-frontend CSS/JS source; no live interaction
context.viewport_render_limitation: Desktop-class rig (Windows 11, no touch screen, no mobile viewport emulator). Cannot produce a phone contact-patch σ_a footprint. Cannot render the mobile viewport (<768px) to confirm width:100% button layout. All target-size measurements are CSS-computed, not live bounding-box measurements. A live browser with setViewport and rendered element.getBoundingClientRect() would produce stronger evidence.

keyboard_path.notes: No keyboard trap found in observed markup. All interactive elements are semantic HTML. Skip link present and correctly targeted. Focus indicator exceeds WCAG 2.4.13. Low finding MA-01 (role=button on anchor with JS Space-key compensation) keeps the section at Warn. Two open questions on mobile nav toggle and tab-panel arrow keys cannot be resolved without live interaction.

pointer_precision.notes: Radio/checkbox inputs are 44x44px (exemplary). Task-list rows have full-row touch target. govuk-button computed height ~40px — 4px below AAA threshold but above 2.5.8 minimum. Change links on check-your-answers are inline text with no padding expansion — Medium finding.

drag_dependence.notes: No drag-operated functions found. File upload uses native input. Date input avoids calendar picker. No sortable lists, kanban, or custom sliders. draggable=false on start-button anchor suppresses (not enables) drag. Section passes cleanly.

timeout_pressure.notes: One High finding: pattern provides no timeout mechanism or guidance. govuk-frontend v6 has no session-timeout component. The pattern targets complex, long-duration flows where this gap is consequential. Cannot elevate to Fail (1 Critical threshold not met; 3 Highs not met — only 1 High). Open question on live service implementations.

undo_recovery.notes: govuk-button uses click (up-event) — WCAG 2.5.2 satisfied. Back link provides pre-submission undo. One High finding (MA-05): Accept and send has no post-submission undo. One Low finding (MA-06): adjacent Change links close together on CYA page. 1 High is below the 3-High Fail threshold; section Warn.

error_recovery.notes: Error summary links navigate directly to failing fields. Error-summary focus management is JS-dependent — one Medium finding. No hover-only content in core components. Open question on custom tooltip usage in real service implementations.

configuration_cost.notes: No in-app accommodation controls to audit; the recursive failure mode is absent. GOV.UK relies on OS-level motor accommodation. Section passes.

evidence.notes: Path 2 DOM-fallback run. No live keyboard session. MA-08 records the keyboard-trap gap. Evidence is substantive (live rendered HTML, govuk-frontend source code), not documentation-only, but the method constraint prevents a Pass. Section 7 Warn is the correct and honest outcome.

findings.title: Start button uses role=button on anchor with JS Space-key compensation
findings.surface: Start now button — any GOV.UK service start page
findings.evidence_summary: Rendered HTML from /components/button/start/index.html: <a href="#" role="button" draggable="false" class="govuk-button govuk-button--start" data-module="govuk-button">. govuk-frontend button.mjs source confirms Space key handling via keydown event synthesis.

findings.title: Change links on check-your-answers page are inline-text targets (~16-24px tall)
findings.evidence_summary: Rendered HTML from /patterns/check-answers/default/index.html shows Change name as inline text link. govuk-link CSS adds no padding or min-height. CSS-computed target height ~24px (font 16px * line-height 1.5). WCAG 2.5.8 spacing exception may apply but cannot be confirmed without live bounding-box measurement.

findings.title: govuk-button computed height (~40px) below 44px AAA target
findings.surface: All question pages, task list, check-your-answers
findings.evidence_summary: CSS: .govuk-button { padding: 8px 10px 7px; border: 2px solid transparent; font-size: 1.1875rem; line-height: 1 }. Computed height = 19 + 8 + 7 + 4 = 38px visible, ~40px with drop-shadow. Passes 2.5.8 (24px) but falls short of 2.5.5 (44px) AAA.

findings.title: Pattern provides no timeout mechanism; implementations may silently discard form data
findings.surface: GOV.UK multi-step form pattern (complete-multiple-tasks, question-pages, check-answers)
findings.evidence_summary: govuk-frontend v6 package list has no session-timeout component (404 at /components/timeout-warning/). complete-multiple-tasks/default HTML has no timeout warning. Pattern documentation does not prescribe WCAG 2.2.1 compliance for implementing services. Reuschel et al. 2023 (finding 27) documents 27x form-completion time ratio on similar complex forms.

findings.title: Accept and send final submission has no post-activation undo path
findings.surface: Check-your-answers pattern — final form submission button
findings.evidence_summary: check-answers/default/index.html: <button type="submit" class="govuk-button">Accept and send</button> in <form action="/form-handler" method="post">. No undo button, no confirmation dialog, no post-submission correction path shown in pattern. govuk-button.mjs binds to click (up-event) — WCAG 2.5.2 satisfied during press, but post-submit no undo exists.

findings.title: Adjacent Change links on check-your-answers may cause tremor overshoot to wrong row
findings.surface: Check-your-answers summary list — multiple adjacent Change links
findings.evidence_summary: check-answers/default/index.html shows 5 sequential govuk-summary-list__row entries each with a Change link. Rows separated by 1px border only. No dead space between adjacent Change link targets. CSS does not add padding to summary-list action links.

findings.title: Error summary focus management is JS-dependent; no-JS path leaves focus at page top
findings.surface: All question pages with validation errors — govuk-error-summary component
findings.evidence_summary: govuk-error-summary rendered HTML: <div class="govuk-error-summary" data-module="govuk-error-summary"><div role="alert">. The data-module attribute is a JS hook; the error-summary module programmatically adds tabindex=-1 and calls .focus() on the container. Without JS, tabindex is absent and focus after form submission stays at top of page. Confirmed by govuk-frontend source analysis.

findings.title: Keyboard trap absence not confirmable from static DOM alone
findings.surface: Full multi-step form flow — audit methodology gap
findings.evidence_summary: No live keyboard Tab-cycle was run. The absence of complex ARIA widgets (no custom date-picker dialogs, no carousels, no embedded players) in observed markup makes a keyboard trap unlikely, but WCAG 2.1.2 keyboard-trap absence requires a live confirmation.

open_questions.summary: Mobile navigation menu toggle keyboard operability under no-JS
open_questions.resolution_path: Open the Design System site with JavaScript disabled and Tab-cycle through the navigation. Also test with JS enabled: Tab to the mobile menu toggle, press Enter and Escape, confirm arrow-key or Tab navigation between nav items.

open_questions.summary: Design System tab-panel (HTML/Nunjucks tabs) arrow-key pattern implementation
open_questions.resolution_path: Tab to any HTML/Nunjucks tab pair on a component page, press Left/Right arrow keys, confirm inter-tab navigation and that Tab moves to tabpanel content. Confirm Escape does not dismiss.

open_questions.summary: Real-world GOV.UK service session timeout keyboard accessibility
open_questions.resolution_path: Select 3-5 live GOV.UK services using the multi-step form pattern. Trigger the session timeout. Attempt extension keyboard-only. Record whether warning appears with adequate time, the extension control is Tab-reachable, the dialog is Escape-dismissible, and form data survives timeout.

open_questions.summary: Hover-only tooltips or custom help text in real service implementations
open_questions.resolution_path: Audit 3-5 live GOV.UK services using the multi-step pattern. Tab through each page with no mouse. Confirm all visible content on hover is also available on focus.

positive_observations.summary: Skip link present and correctly targeted on every example page; govuk-skip-link JS validates target on init
Focus indicator exceeds WCAG 2.4.13: yellow background fill + 4px black underline shadow, applied consistently across all interactive elements
All interactive elements use semantic HTML (button, a, input, fieldset) — no div-with-click-handler pattern found
Back link is a native anchor (govuk-back-link) — keyboard-native, no ARIA override, no JS dependency
Radio and checkbox inputs are 44x44px (WCAG 2.5.5 AAA) — exemplary for the most-tapped targets in question pages
Task-list row links expand to full-row touch target via absolute-positioned pseudo-element — correct pattern for large touch targets on list items
File upload is a native input type=file — always presents Choose File button; WCAG 2.5.7 satisfied by default
Date input uses plain text fields (no calendar picker widget) — eliminates drag-dependence and keyboard-trap risk
govuk-button binds to click event (up-event) — satisfies WCAG 2.5.2 Pointer Cancellation; slide-off abort is available to pointer users
Back link on every question page and check-your-answers enables pre-submission correction with a single keyboard interaction
Error summary links navigate directly to the failing field by ID — correct, motor-efficient recovery pattern

Pattern relies on OS/browser-level accommodation (prefers-reduced-motion, forced colours, browser zoom) by design — avoids the recursive failure mode where an accessibility control requires the capability it grants

exit_criteria_check.input_mode_gap_documented: Path 2 DOM-fallback; no live keyboard-only or single-pointer-no-drag interaction performed; gap documented in Section 7 finding MA-08 and scorecard evidence_mode
